svg.title: Spark-X2.6-1.7B inference speed
svg.desc: Prefill and decode throughput across 4K, 32K and 128K context lengths. Two separate test groups. Higher is better. Missing measurements are omitted. Hardware: Mac M5 Pro, 16-core, and RTX 4090.

g.text: Throughput across context lengths · Y-axes do not start at zero
